state: A nonconducting sphere is given a nonzero net electric charge, +Q, and then brought close to a neutral conducting sphere of the same radius. Which of the following will be true?

answer.instructions: Which option is the correct answer to the question above?

criteria.A: An electric field will be induced within the conducting sphere.
criteria.B: The conducting sphere will develop a net electric charge of –Q.
criteria.C: The spheres will experience an electrostatic attraction.
criteria.D: The spheres will experience an electrostatic repulsion.
